text:
By Jessica On The ,
1 hours ago
One thing that we all have in common in this…we all have a day where we get to celebrate our big moment of arrival. Our Birthday!
According to Brookings , about 20 million people celebrate a birthday on the same day. This year, my birthday also landed on Easter.
Close to 47% of people aren’t super fans when it comes to their birthday. For quite a few of us, including myself, our day is just another day. But a few years ago, someone surprised me. After years of not really celebrating my big day, I walked into a room and it was full of decorations that caught me by complete surprise ! That was the moment I decided to just think of my day of arriving in this world as an adventure…an adventure of freebies!
You can basically fill up on free food and drinks all day. If you don’t know about the free birthday gifts companies are waiting to hand out, I’ll walk you through some of the best below.

Check Out This Gigantic List of Freebies You Can Get in Minnesota , Iowa, and Wisconsin On Your Birthday! My hunt for free stuff on my birthday led me to a bunch of fun surprises!
My alma mater, Iowa State University, sent me a special birthday greeting . My financial planner and Delta Air Lines sent me a birthday wish. And I found a few freebies you can enjoy throughout Minnesota, Iowa, and Wisconsin, too .
